$comment: Completion bar for #138: test whether raw transcripts outrank the user's notes in Ask, then implement notes-first retrieval (confirmed). Adds a fixture-vault smoke test (test:notes-vs-transcripts) that runs real searchQuery and asserts notes rank before transcripts with sourcesLast=true, and transcripts stay ranked in Media chat (sourcesLast=false). searchQuery gains a sourcesLast option (ORDER BY (kind='transcript'), score); askGrounded and sendChatTurn default it true (Ask notes-first), Media chat passes false (transcript-first). Finding: verbatim transcripts did outrank paraphrased notes, so the change is justified. #37 (stopword FTS) remains separate.

criteria.target: grep -q "sourcesLast" electron/search.ts && grep -q "sourcesLast" electron/generate.ts && grep -q "sourcesLast" electron/chat.ts && grep -q "sourcesLast: false" src/plugins/media-chat/MediaChatView.tsx
